description_clean:
A World-Changing Company
 
Palantir builds the world’s leading software for data-driven decisions and operations. By bringing the right data to the people who need it, our platforms empower our partners to develop lifesaving drugs, forecast supply chain disruptions, locate missing children, and more.The Role
 

We are a software engineering team applying open-source data technologies to some of the world’s hardest and most important problems. We build the data processing infrastructure that underpins Palantir Foundry, supporting applications that help hospitals care for more patients, help clinical teams coordinate timely diagnoses, and keep essential supplies moving through global disruption.
 
You will work deep inside the systems that make this possible: how computations are represented, how query plans are optimized, how operators execute, and how data is read and written efficiently. We build on and extend Apache Spark, Apache DataFusion, and Apache Iceberg, bringing advances in open-source engines and table formats into the demanding environments our customers operate in. Our work serves many products and workloads across Foundry, including no-code pipelines, interactive analysis, and the processing that keeps the Ontology up to date.
 
You will own improvements from design through production, whether that means developing a planning rule, extending a native execution engine, or improving the way large tables are scanned and updated. Correctness, compatibility, and predictable performance are central to everything we build. A change in a shared engine can benefit applications across the platform and the people who rely on them.
 
Join us if you want to advance the capabilities of modern data systems and apply that work to consequential problems.

Java, Scala, Rust, and Python
Apache Spark, Apache DataFusion, Apache Comet, and Velox for data processing and query execution

Apache Arrow and Apache Parquet for in-memory data processing and columnar storage
Industry-standard build tooling, including Gradle, Cargo, and GitHub.

Blueprint as a re-usable front end component library.
A combination of open-source and internal technologies that suit the problems at hand.
Industry-standard build tooling, including Gradle, Webpack, GitHub, and CircleCI.

MoonPay Enterprise is for builders with something to prove.
This isn't a "work on cool crypto stuff" company. It's a high-standards, high-velocity, high-accountability company building the operating system for value movement. If the internet moves information, we move value: crypto, stablecoins, tokenized assets, and whatever comes next. Four offerings make that real: fund, tokenize, trade, and spend.
MoonPay Enterprise is the fund layer built for businesses. We power how stablecoins move through real financial operations: enterprises, fintechs, PSPs, wallets, and marketplaces running their treasuries, their cross-border flows, and their stablecoin operations on us. The goal is to make moving real money at scale as predictable as any other piece of financial infrastructure, with the compliance and controls CFOs need to say yes.
AI is the default operating mode here. It's woven into every role, and we expect you to use it daily. It handles the manual work so you can deliver on what actually matters.
You'll thrive here if outcomes excite you more than process, if impact motivates you more than titles, and if you want hard problems, real ownership, and teammates who love winning, building, and doing it together.
The bar is high. The pace is real. We're building the rails that businesses run real money on, for humans and agents. MoonPay ranked #2 in Crypto Services on Fortune's inaugural Crypto 100, made Forbes' America's Best Startup Employers 2026 (Top 25 in Finance), and landed on The Sunday Times Best Places to Work two years running.About MoonPay Enterprise
MoonPay Enterprise is one of the more operationally complex products in the stablecoin space: multiple banking providers, multiple payment rails, a growing partner base across two product lines (Orchestration and Issuance), and an active compliance surface across each. MoonPay Enterprise runs B2B, B2B2B, and B2B2C models. Partners integrate our API. Their customers become direct customers of MoonPay Enterprise for compliance purposes.
KYB is the front door. Every partner is a business. Every business customer of every partner clears KYB before a single transaction moves. Today the flow is part automated registry verification, part manual review, with different rules for the US and the rest of the world, and turnaround measured in days. That does not scale to where MoonPay Enterprise is going. KYB has to become a product: measurable, fast, API-first, defensible in front of regulators and banking partners. This is a principal seat. You set the multi-year direction for how businesses enter MoonPay Enterprise, and you own the outcome.
What You'll Own
KYB product strategy & roadmap


Business onboarding end-to-end, across every model MoonPay Enterprise runs: partners onboarding onto MoonPay Enterprise, businesses onboarding directly, and business customers onboarding through partners.


Platform altitude. KYB decisions ripple into KYC, Travel Rule capture, banking-provider onboarding, and Issuance partner diligence. Connect the surfaces; don't optimise one in isolation.


MoonPay Enterprise runs three KYC delivery models (reliance, outsourcing, hosted). KYB coverage is uneven across them. You decide where it expands and in what order.


Genuine product depth on MoonPay Enterprise is non-negotiable. Within weeks you talk fluently about KYB outcomes, UBO requirements, virtual account structures, and API behaviour. From being hands-on, not from documentation.


Onboarding funnel & conversion


The KYB funnel is yours: pass rate, time-to-verified against a 48-72h target, manual review rate, drop-off per step.


Instrument what isn't instrumented. Make approval speed and rejection quality measurable. Then move both.


Fix rejection UX. Today a declined business often gets a status without a reason, and the partner escalates to support to find out what is missing. Rejection reasons, retry semantics, and resubmission flows become API surface partners build on.


KYB API & partner experience


The KYB API surface: statuses, webhooks, document submission, and the edge cases that make business onboarding hard (sole proprietors, corporate shareholders, one person who is UBO, Director, and Representative at once).


Partners integrate KYB in weeks and self-serve their onboarding questions. Every "what is missing for this customer" escalation is a product gap. Close it.


Compliance as product


Turn compliance-approved onboarding matrices into product logic. US and non-US differ: control prong versus directors, when ownership documents are required, self-certification options. Partners should never need to read a matrix.


EDD triggers, high-risk classification, prohibited industries, Travel Rule capture: you decide how they show up in the product.


Compliance is your sparring partner, not a ticket queue. You shape how policy becomes product. They own the policy.


Vendor & provider orchestration


The verification stack (SumSub today) and the build-versus-buy calls around it.


Cost per verification, automation rate, vendor performance. Know when a second provider, a waterfall, or in-house tooling earns its place.


Push automation. Decide where AI-assisted review with a human in the loop replaces manual queues, and prove it does not raise risk.


Every new banking provider brings its own onboarding requirements. Keep KYB compatible with every rail without collecting everything from everyone.

A principal-level PM with real KYB or KYC depth. You have owned onboarding, identity, verification, or risk as a platform, not a feature.


High agency. You do not wait for a mandate, a brief, or perfect data. You find the problem, claim it, and fix it.


Full autonomy, zero to one. Hand you an unowned surface and you take it from first principles to shipped. No handover document, no waiting for direction.

Compliance is a design constraint, not a blocker. You read a requirements matrix and see API design, funnel steps, and copy.


You know your funnel cold: pass rate, time-to-verified, manual review rate, cost per verification.


At home in API-first B2B. Your users are partner engineers and the businesses behind them, not consumers.


You have run verification vendors (SumSub, Persona, or equivalents) and know when to switch, stack, or build.


A multiplier for the product team around you. You raise the bar for how compliance-heavy product work gets scoped, specced, and shipped.


Bias to action. Reactive stewardship of an existing flow is not what we are hiring for.

Company Overview:
At Panopto, we are the most customer-centric learning technology company in the world. Position Summary 
In this role, you will have the opportunity to do the most impactful work of your career, elevating your craft while contributing to a team that values lifelong learning.
As the Senior Project Manager, you'll report to the Program Manager and sit inside the Product team on the R&D side, which means the job runs in both directions. Upstream, you're working with Product Managers, Engineering, and Design to keep committed work moving, dependencies visible, and slippage caught early. Downstream, you're making sure Marketing has positioning, Support knows what's changing, Sales can sell it, and customers hear about it the day it goes live.
 
Most project management roles are one or the other. This one is deliberately both, because the handoffs between them are where things fall apart.
You'll take initiatives that start as a paragraph and a target quarter, break them into a plan people can act on, and keep a distributed group of teams moving in the same direction until it's out the door. This role is for someone energized rather than frustrated by ambiguity — you'll frequently be the person who turns "we're doing this next quarter" into a sequenced plan with owners and dates, and then holds everyone to it. 
You’ll also have opportunities to contribute to other initiatives that directly advance our core values and support you in elevating your craft.
How You’ll Contribute 
In this role, you will have the opportunity to


Own the end-to-end plan for assigned initiatives — scope, sequence, dependencies, milestones, and readiness criteria from commitment through release.


Break large, ambiguous initiatives into discrete workstreams with clear owners, and keep the group aligned as things shift.


Work alongside Product Managers and Engineering Leads to track delivery against commitments, surface slippage early, and keep cross-team dependencies visible and resolved.


Facilitate the sessions that move work forward — dependency reviews, cross-team planning, release readiness — and make sure they end in decisions.


Translate engineering blockers and technical trade-offs into clear, honest updates for Product leadership and commercial stakeholders.


Drive go-to-market readiness with Product Marketing, Sales Enablement, Support, and Customer Success so enablement lands with the release, not after it.


Coordinate internal and customer-facing release communications, including release notes.


Build the templates, checklists, and repeatable processes that make the next release easier than the last one — using AI tooling to cut the manual overhead.


 
What Success Looks Like 


Within 3 months: You've built working relationships across Product, Engineering, Marketing, and Support, and you own end-to-end coordination for two or more active initiatives — running the delivery cadence with the dev teams and producing status reporting people actually read.


Within 6 months: You're anticipating blockers rather than reporting them, and releases you coordinate go out with GTM readiness in place on day one.


Within 1 year: You run our most complex, multi-team initiatives with minimal oversight, and the delivery and launch process you've built is what the rest of the team uses by default.


Your legacy: Panopto ships predictably, and every team knows what's coming and what they need to do about it — because you built the system that makes that true.


Values in Action


Customer First, Always: You proactively surface friction points in the customer experience before they are escalated — and propose solutions, not just reports.


Thrive Together: You share work-in-progress for early feedback, knowing that challenge improves the outcome. You separate critiques of ideas from critiques of people.


Elevate the Craft: You hold the bar high on your own work and invest in developing those around you. You treat every project as an opportunity to learn something new.


Act with Ownership: You define success by outcomes, not activity. You flag problems early and bring a proposed path forward, not just the problem.


Clarity Over Complexity: You default to the simpler solution. Your written communication — internal or external — is direct, specific, and free of filler.


How We Thrive
You'll join a team where we challenge ideas, not people. The Product organization exists to ideate, define, and deliver best-in-class products to our customers — assessing market trends, running competitive and customer research, and ruthlessly prioritizing the opportunities with the highest return. We hold ourselves accountable to outcomes, not activity.
 
The Foundation for Success


6+ years of project or program management experience, with at least 4+ years specifically embedded within a B2B SaaS Product or R&D organization.


Bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience.


Demonstrated experience running delivery with software engineering teams and coordinating the go-to-market side of a product launch. This role does both.


Proven experience driving delivery for complex SaaS architectures (e.g., API integrations, multi-tenant cloud platforms, feature flags, continuous deployment release models). 


Working understanding of the SaaS product lifecycle and agile delivery practices, with the judgment to adapt the process to the situation rather than apply it by the book.


Enough technical fluency to hold a credible conversation with engineers about dependencies, trade-offs, and blockers — you don't need to write code, but you can't be a passenger in the discussion.


Proficiency with Jira and Confluence for planning, tracking, and documentation.


Strong written and verbal communication, including the ability to push back constructively on scope creep.


Experience working with distributed teams across multiple time zones.


Demonstrated track record of designing, implementing, or improving cross-functional delivery and GTM release frameworks, rather than just executing within existing ones. 


 
What Sets You Apart


Experience coordinating GTM launch activities with Product Marketing, Sales Enablement, or Customer Success.


Experience presenting, reporting delivery health, and managing trade-offs directly with VP and C-level stakeholders.


Experience sitting inside a Product or R&D organization rather than a central PMO.


Active PMP, PMI-ACP, or CSM certification.


Hands-on experience leveraging modern PM stacks (Jira, Confluence) and AI productivity tools to streamline status reporting, documentation, and risk analysis. 


Prior experience in a Product Operations (ProdOps) function.


Familiarity with API-based products, feature flagging, or cloud service constraints.


Experience in EdTech or with higher education or enterprise customers.


Practical use of AI tooling to accelerate planning, synthesis, and reporting work.

User Research & Discovery

Own field research: contextual inquiry, user interviews, and observation of how teams actually work with AI and where it breaks.
Build and maintain a deep understanding of our core users — individual contributors, champions, managers, and corporate buyers — and the context they operate in.
Synthesize messy field data into sharp, actionable insight: jobs-to-be-done, adoption blockers, and the conditions under which a skill transfers between people.
Establish a continuous discovery habit so research is a foundational reflex, and champion the user's perspective in every product decision.

 
Product & Experience Design

What our experts do by hand today is the spec for what the product must automate tomorrow. Your job is to watch that closely enough to design it.
Design the surfaces: the client dashboard execs present to their board, the internal console our experts use to run a dozen live communities at once, and the conversations themselves.
Most of our product lives inside someone else's client. You are designing in Teams and Slack, not screens we control — no onboarding, no landing page, no second chance. A four-minute message to an accountant who has never opened Copilot is the hardest design problem we have.
Work mostly on enterprise, and partly on higher education, where we also have live deployments. Two audiences, two vocabularies, one product: part of your job is deciding what stays shared and what has to differ, so we build one coherent system rather than two half-products.

Raison is on a mission to provide humans with better skills so they can feel confident and have more opportunities in the AI era. We help companies make sure 100% their teams master AI, directly in the flow of work (Teams, Slack) so that AI knowledge spreads across the organization instead of pooling in a handful of champions.
We are passionate entrepreneurs believing that the ongoing AI revolution should be shared by all employees; and that the future of corporate interactions should not be restricted to private human-machine chats. Raison is capturing what champions create with AI, turning it into shared, governed skills, and propagating them so everyone feels capable and empowered; acting as a powerful lever to accelerate the AI transformation of corporates.
We recently raised €2m from a top French VC + BPI and a selection of high-profile business angels who believe AI mastery is the highest-leverage application of AI inside companies. We are signing our first corporate design partnerships this September.

Tasks
Founding Business Development Representative

We are looking for a Founding BDR to open Raison's pipeline. You will find the companies where AI has been deployed but isn't actually used, reach the person who has to answer for it, and turn that conversation into a qualified meeting with our Account Executive and founders.
You will reach out to Transformation leads, Heads of AI, CFOs and COOs in mid-sized companies at the moment something forces them to act: their board, CEO or PE fund is asking what AI has delivered, or the person who carried the AI program is leaving. Our wedge isn't one more training session. It's making AI stick across every team, and showing what actually changed. You'll need to tell that story in two sentences, on the phone and in writing.
As a founding commercial hire, you'll work hand-in-hand with the CEO, our AE and the founding GTM/Ops. What you hear in the field will shape who we target and how we talk to them.
This role is perfect for someone early in their sales career who'd rather learn by building than by running someone else's script: no inbound engine, no big brand yet; only a sharp story, real signals and you.

What you will do:

Spot the signals that matter before anyone else: a new Head of AI, a departing AI champion, an AI committee being set up, a board or fund pushing on AI, then reach the right person.
Run personalized outbound on LinkedIn, email and phone. Our best results come from one well-researched message, not a hundred automated ones.
Qualify every conversation against what actually predicts a deal: has the company already started acting on this before talking to us? Who is asking for results, and by when?
Book qualified meetings for our AE and founders, with a clean handoff: the trigger, the team, the buyer.
Feed what you hear straight back to the team (objections, vocabulary, which titles answer and which don't)

Requirements
Who you are:

1–3 years in a sales, BDR/SDR or growth role, ideally in B2B SaaS or consulting.
You write short, sharp messages that people answer, and you're comfortable on the phone with a C/VP-level.
You use AI every day, including to research your prospects.
You're resilient: most messages won't get a reply, and you treat every "no" as data.
Organized and rigorous: you log everything, because we learn from patterns, not anecdotes.
Fluent in French and English.
You want to grow into an AE role as the company scales.

Benefits

A founding role with equity and direct influence on company strategy.
Competitive salary, benchmarked to the Paris startup ecosystem.
Flexibility: remote-friendly with regular in-person collaboration in Paris and an office in Montmartre with a beautiful Sacré-Coeur view.
A front-row seat to one of the most important shifts in how humans learn.
A small, sharp team that ships fast and trusts each other to figure things out.

If you want ownership, equity, and the kind of career-defining challenge that only comes from being early, we'd love to hear from you. Apply now and join Raison at the forefront of the AI-for-learning revolution.

title: Edge & Machine Integration Engineer (PLC to Cloud), Freelance, m/f/d
description_clean:
FALU AG in Rüti (ZH) builds and sells swab production machines that run in plants around the world. With FALU PMAS, our cloud based production monitoring and assistance system, every machine reports its state every five seconds. Customers get live dashboards, shift KPIs, downtime analytics and automatic alerts in the browser. The first customer went live in September 2026 with eight machines, and more plants are lined up.
The cloud side of PMAS is built and running in production: broker, ingestion service, databases, web app. The path from the PLC inside the machine to the MQTT broker is covered by one engineer who designed and built it. With more machines and more plants coming, that one person is no longer enough. We are looking for a freelancer who adds capacity on exactly this path: PLC software, Raspberry Pi edge devices, site gateway, broker connection.
This is a permanent role that we staff on a freelance basis: no project end date, a long term engagement with about 1 week of work per month, with more when a rollout is on. You will work directly with our existing integration engineer, our inhouse engineering team and the CEO.
Tasks
You work on everything between the machine PLC and the MQTT broker, alongside the engineer who built the current setup. Which parts you take over completely and which you share depends on your strengths. Concretely:
PLC and machine side

Bring the PMAS message format into the CB1 machine software (Siemens S7, TIA Portal V18 with HMI) and keep it in sync with the payload contract: cumulative counters, machine status, error codes, timestamps from the PLC clock.
Decide and implement how data leaves the PLC: MQTT publishing from the PLC itself, or a read on the edge device (S7 protocol or OPC UA) that publishes on its behalf. Pick one, justify it, standardise it.
Manage PLC software versions across the fleet, including safe update and rollback procedures for machines already running at customers.
Ensure clock discipline on the PLCs (NTP, local time zone per plant), since every duration KPI is computed from PLC timestamps.

Edge devices and site gateway

Develop and maintain the software on the Raspberry Pi based edge devices next to each machine: MQTT client, buffering and store and forward during uplink outages, unique client IDs, credential handling, health reporting.
Develop and maintain the site gateway: isolated machine network, routing and firewall, outbound only TLS and NTP, remote maintenance access, watchdogs, recovery from a spare device.
Help turn the current setup into a provisioning process: golden image, per machine configuration, fleet wide updates without a site visit. A new machine goes from unboxing to "visible in the dashboard" in under an hour.
Monitor the edge layer so that we know about a degraded device before the customer does.

Broker and data contract

Administer the HiveMQ Cloud clusters per customer: credentials, topic ACLs, client ID scheme, certificates.
Maintain the payload contract together with the existing integration engineer. Changes are versioned and documented.

Commissioning and support

Onboard new customers and new machines end to end, remotely where possible and on site where needed (primarily Europe and the United States).
Act as second line when "the dashboard shows nothing" or "the numbers look wrong" and the cause sits between PLC and broker.
Write the documentation you would have wanted on day one: onboarding sheets, runbooks, wiring notes.

Requirements
Must have

Siemens PLC programming in TIA Portal (SCL and LAD, S7-1200/1500 family). You can open an existing machine project, understand it and change it without breaking the machine.
Industrial networking: PROFINET, VLANs, static and DHCP setups, firewalls, TLS basics. You have connected a machine to a network that was not built for it.
Linux on Raspberry Pi or comparable single board computers: systemd, networking, images, headless operation, remote administration.
Solid programming skills in Python or Node.js for edge software, and Git as a daily tool.
MQTT in depth: versions 3.1.1 and 5.0, QoS levels, retained messages, last will, TLS, broker ACLs.
Proficiency with AI coding tools is a hard requirement. You use Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot or comparable tools every day, you write and maintain project instructions for them, you review their output critically, and you are measurably faster with them than without. Our code and documentation are written with and for these tools. If you see AI tools as optional, this role is not for you.
Working proficiency in English (all code, commits and documentation are in English). German is a plus for the machine side.
Willingness to travel to customer plants, typically a few days per quarter.
Availability of at least two days per week on a permanent basis, with the option to scale up during rollouts.
You work as a freelancer (own company or registered self employed) and can invoice FALU AG.

Nice to have

OPC UA, Snap7 or the Siemens open communication libraries.
Node-RED, Docker on ARM, Ansible or similar fleet tooling.
Machine building or commissioning experience: reading electrical schematics, 24 V control cabinet basics, HMI (WinCC).
Administration of HiveMQ, Mosquitto or EMQX.
A basic understanding of what happens after the broker (Node.js services, PostgreSQL, ClickHouse), so that you can talk to the cloud side at eye level.

Benefits

A clearly bounded, business critical scope with a colleague who knows the system and hands over properly. No cold start.
A running production system with a real customer, not a greenfield slide deck.
AI assisted development is how we work, not an experiment. You get the tools and the budget for them.
Machines you can touch: a test bench at FALU in Rüti with real PLCs and edge hardware.
Remote by default, on site in Rüti when hardware is involved. Travel to customer plants is paid on top of the rate.
A permanent role, not a project with an end date: growing volume as more plants go live, on a freelance basis for as long as it works for both sides.
Fast, uncomplicated invoicing and decisions from a small team.

If you have ever made a stubborn PLC talk to the cloud and have capacity to do it again with us, we would like to hear from you.
Please send us your CV or LinkedIn profile, your daily rate and availability, one paragraph about a PLC to cloud integration you built or fixed and what went wrong on the way, and one concrete example of how you use AI tools in your daily engineering work.
What to expect: a short call with Marc Wyss (CEO) within a week of your application, then a small practical task with a simulated PLC data source, a Raspberry Pi image and a broker endpoint. We look at how you work, not just at the result. title: Cloud Operations Lead
description_clean:

Cloud Operations Lead (80-100%)
to join our team. In this role, you own the daily operation of our cloud platform: availability, incidents, recovery, and the service desk that customers reach first. When something has to keep running at Xelon, you make it run.
At Xelon, we deliver secure, scalable, and automated Swiss cloud infrastructure for the next generation of digital services. From IaaS to SaaS, our platform powers workloads in regulated industries like technology, finance, insurance, and public services. Our solutions - Xelon Cloud, Xelon Secure+ and Xelon HQ combine reliability, automation, sovereignty, and simplicity in one ecosystem.
We are on a mission to become the #1 Swiss Cloud Enabler, and we are growing a team of people who want to shape the future of cloud infrastructure and software operations.
Tasks
Your Mission
As Cloud Operations Lead you own the daily operation of our cloud platform: availability, incident response, monitoring, backup and recovery, and the infrastructure underneath. The service desk is part of your team, so you also own what customers experience every time they contact us. You lead a team of four to six people, and you are the person the business relies on when something has to keep running.
Xelon is building a new platform over the coming years. VMware carries the production estate through that transition and stays in place for at least the next two years, alongside other hypervisors. You run that environment, you keep it stable and auditable, and you make sure the transition never happens at the expense of the customers on it.
Platform strategy, target architecture and the technology roadmap sit with the Head of Platform & Technology. You are a close partner in those decisions and you own their operational reality.
What You Own in the First 12 Months

Availability and customer satisfaction. You hit the agreed availability targets and hold them, and customers experience both the platform and the service desk as dependable, with incidents resolved quickly and communicated clearly.
ISO 27001 and audit readiness. Operational evidence, documentation and patch compliance stay audit-ready throughout the year instead of being assembled in the weeks before each audit.
Team depth. No critical part of the platform depends on one person, and every engineer in the team has a development path they can name.

Responsibilities

Operations and multi-hypervisor environment: Operate and optimise the production estate across a multi-hypervisor environment, with VMware as the primary platform. Keep availability, performance and capacity ahead of demand as the customer base grows. Own hardware lifecycle, capacity planning and datacenter operations together with our partners.
Networking, storage and datacenter: Own the operational side of network and storage: segmentation, routing, firewalling, DNS, load balancing, and the storage layer underneath the platform. Raise the level of networking knowledge and practice across the team.
Monitoring, incident response and recovery: Run and improve monitoring, alerting and logging so that problems surface before customers report them. Own backup and disaster recovery, including proving that restores actually work.
Service desk and customer support: Lead the service desk: intake, triage, ticket quality and response times against agreed service levels. Own what customers experience when they contact us, from the first response through to clear communication during an incident. Act as escalation point for 1st and 2nd level support incidents. Turn recurring tickets into fixes together with the engineering side of the team, rather than absorbing them as routine.
Team leadership: Lead, coach and develop a team of four to six people across cloud operations and the service desk. Build development plans and remove single points of knowledge. Set on-call, shift and service desk coverage the team can sustain.
Automation and process: Move recurring manual operations into Infrastructure as Code and scripting. Improve the operational toolchain and the handover points with DevOps, Support and Product. Apply service management practice where it reduces friction, not as an end in itself.
Compliance and audit readiness: Keep operations aligned with ISO 27001, ISAE and Swiss data sovereignty requirements. Work with Dev- and SecOps on hardening, patch compliance and audit evidence. Maintain operational documentation that holds up in an audit.
Budget, vendors and procurement: Co-own the operational CAPEX and OPEX budget with the Head of Platform & Technology. Manage vendor relationships, licenses and procurement for the operations estate.

Requirements
Who You Are
We are looking for an operations leader, not an architect. Technical depth matters, and so does the ability to run a team through a platform transition without dropping the service underneath it.

You keep the service running while the ground moves. A platform transition does not become the customer's problem.
You lead through presence and clarity, not authority. Your team knows what good looks like.
You are calm in an incident and precise afterwards. The postmortem produces a fix, not a narrative.
You treat the service desk as part of the product, not as a queue to be absorbed.
You tell your manager what is broken and what you need to fix it.

Must Haves

Leadership: 5+ years leading IT operations, in a cloud, hosting or service provider environment.
VMware: hands-on experience in production. You have operated it yourself, not only overseen it.
Infrastructure: practical working knowledge of networking, storage and datacenter operations.
German and English: you communicate confidently in both, spoken and written.
Work authorisation: Swiss or EU/EFTA citizenship, or a valid Swiss work permit.

Nice to Haves

Networking at provider scale — a strong plus: segmentation, routing, firewalling, load balancing and DNS.
Experience with other hypervisors alongside VMware, and with hypervisor migrations.
Hands-on Infrastructure as Code, e.g. Terraform or Ansible.
Monitoring and logging at scale, e.g. Prometheus, Grafana or a similar stack.
Operating experience in a regulated environment: ISO 27001, ISAE or SOC 2.
Running operations through a platform migration or a consolidation.

Benefits
What Xelon Offers

A leadership role with real ownership in a Swiss cloud provider, not a coordination layer.
A platform in transition, which means your operational decisions change something visible.
Office in Zug with a hybrid working model, 80 to 100 percent.
Direct collaboration with the Head of Platform & Technology and cross-functional teams.
A team small enough that you know what everyone is working on.
Competitive salary, modern tooling and a product-driven environment with clarity and ownership.

title: Chief Operating Officer (COO)
description_clean:
VAULTED AG is a Swiss deep-tech scale-up born out of research at ETH Zurich and the EMPA innovation ecosystem. We combine world-class engineering, computational design, digital fabrication, and advanced manufacturing to rethink how buildings are designed and delivered, at a time when AI, automation, and data-driven design are transforming the industry.
Our core technology is the Rippmann Floor System® (RFS), a lightweight, prefabricated structural floor system that reduces concrete use by up to 70%, steel use by up to 90%, and embodied carbon by up to 75% compared with conventional concrete slabs. After years of research and technology development, VAULTED is entering a major growth phase across Switzerland, Belgium, the UK, and the US.
Location: Dübendorf ZH, Switzerland · Start date: Q1 2027 · 100% · Reporting to the CEO
Tasks
We are hiring a Chief Operating Officer to build the operational engine that turns confirmed projects into reliable, profitable, and scalable delivery. This is a senior leadership role for someone who combines deep project and construction industry understanding with strong operational and commercial judgement, but also someone who is very hands-on and enjoys setting up the systems and processes behind our operations.
The COO takes ownership once a project is won and oversees project delivery, project management, supplier and prefabrication partnerships, operational contracting, and project economics. The role ensures that scope, timelines, quality, risks, resources, costs, and margins are transparent and actively managed, while giving project teams the structure and support they need to deliver.
A core mandate is to make VAULTED better with every project: translate project learnings into stronger processes, supplier setups, handovers, delivery standards, and feedback to engineering and R&D. The COO builds the operational capabilities required to scale across Switzerland, Belgium, the UK, and the US without adding unnecessary complexity. This is a 100% role.

Operational leadership & project delivery: Build and lead the operating model required to deliver VAULTED projects reliably and efficiently. Oversee the project management function, set clear execution standards, and support escalation and decision-making on active projects.
Project economics & controlling: Establish disciplined project controlling across budgets, costs, forecasts, changes, and margins, ensuring deviations and commercial implications are visible early and actively addressed.
Supplier, production & prefabrication ecosystem: Identify, evaluate, negotiate, and manage production partners, suppliers, and prefabricators across relevant markets, ensuring quality, capacity, cost competitiveness, and delivery reliability.
Contracting, procurement & operational risk: Shape supplier and operational contracts, procurement approaches, and partnership models that improve delivery certainty, manage risk, protect margins, and maintain strategic flexibility.
Cross-functional leadership & resources: Connect project management, engineering, design, R&D, commercial teams, and external partners. Create clarity on priorities, responsibilities, capacity, and trade-offs, and ensure smooth handovers from sales into execution.
Continuous improvement & international scaling: Turn project learnings into better processes, standards, supplier setups, and execution methods, while building operational readiness for Switzerland, Belgium, the UK, the US, and future markets.

Requirements

Typically 8+ years of relevant experience in project delivery, operations, construction, architecture, or prefabrication, preferably with an engineering background.
Proven responsibility for complex, multi-stakeholder projects or project portfolios, with the ability to oversee execution while staying close enough to intervene when needed.
Strong practical understanding of how construction or engineered products move from design and procurement through production, coordination, and delivery.
Strong commercial and financial discipline, including project budgets, cost drivers, forecasting, margins, change management, and operational risk.
Experience negotiating and managing suppliers, production partners, contracts, and long-term operational relationships.
Strong leadership skills with high empathy and high standards: able to build trust, set clear expectations, challenge constructively, make decisions, and hold teams and partners to commitments.
Strategic and hands-on working style: able to build scalable systems and processes while staying pragmatic, close to project realities, and comfortable solving difficult execution issues.
Fluency in English is required; German is a strong advantage. Based in Zurich/Dübendorf, or willing to work primarily from Dübendorf, with occasional national and international travel to project, production, and construction sites.

title: Transmission Belt Reinforcement Business Development Director
description_clean:
Aritec New Materials Group AG is a Swiss-based company specialized in fiber composite solutions for demanding industrial applications.  
We are experts in synthetic fibers, treatments & fiber sizing formulations and polymer matrices. We take pride in engineering and optimizing superior solutions to the most complex industrial challenges.  
At Aritec, we drive tomorrow’s industrial frontiers by innovating cost-effective and robust solutions.
Tasks
We are seeking an accomplished Transmission Belt Reinforcement Business Development Director to lead commercial growth for advanced reinforcement solutions used in industrial transmission belts (timing, power transmission, etc..). This is a senior, customer-facing role for a commercially driven technical professional who understands belt construction, reinforcement architecture, manufacturing processes, end-user performance requirements, and the evolving challenges facing belt manufacturers and end-users worldwide.
The successful candidate will bring a strong track record and industry network from a leading belt manufacturer or closely related high-performance belting business. They will use their industry credibility, technical depth, and commercial judgment to build strategic customer relationships, identify new growth opportunities, and position our reinforcement portfolio as a performance-enabling solution for next-generation belt designs.
As Business Development Director, you will work at the intersection of materials engineering, belt design, manufacturing, and commercial strategy. You will engage with global belt manufacturers, technical centers, R&D teams, purchasing organizations, and senior business leaders to advance qualification projects and convert them into durable commercial programs.
Key Responsibilities

Define and execute the global sales strategy for Aritec reinforcement portfolio in Transmission belts.
Build and manage senior-level relationships with major transmission-belt manufacturers, including engineering, R&D, purchasing, operations, quality, and executive leadership.
Manage and Expand existing customers account portfolio by identifying and prioritizing opportunities where Aritec Synthetic reinforcement technology can improve belt strength, fatigue performance, dimensional stability, heat resistance, flex life, adhesion, noise behavior, efficiency, or durability.
Translate customer performance requirements into clear technical and commercial value propositions.
Lead customer-development programs from initial technical discussion through sampling, testing, qualification, industrialization, and serial-production launch.
Coordinate closely with internal R&D, application engineering, operations, quality, product management, and supply-chain teams to ensure customer requirements are understood and delivered.
Provide informed market intelligence on belt technologies, competitive reinforcement materials, regional market dynamics, pricing trends, supply-chain risks, and emerging end-use requirements.
Support the development of account plans, commercial agreements, pricing strategies, forecasts, and long-term supply arrangements.
Represent the company at customer technical reviews, industry events, trade fairs, and relevant technical associations.
Establish disciplined sales reporting, opportunity qualification, forecasting, and business-review processes.
Mentor and develop regional sales or application-engineering colleagues as the business grows.

Requirements
Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Materials Science, Polymer Science, Chemical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or a comparable technical discipline.
At least 10 years of relevant commercial, technical-sales, business-development, product-management, application-engineering, or R&D experience in transmission belts, reinforced elastomer products, industrial belting, tire cord, technical textiles, fibers, or closely related applications.
Experience gained at a recognized transmission-belt manufacturer is strongly preferred. Candidates from leading global manufacturers of automotive and industrial transmission belts will be particularly well suited.
Demonstrated understanding of transmission-belt construction, including reinforcement cords or fabrics, rubber compounds, bonding systems, cover materials, belt geometry, and manufacturing processes.
Practical familiarity with belt types such as timing belts, synchronous belts, V-belts, multi-rib belts, variable-speed belts, flat belts, and industrial power-transmission belts.
Strong understanding of key reinforcement performance factors, including tensile properties, modulus, elongation, creep, fatigue, flex resistance, adhesion, thermal stability, moisture behavior, dimensional stability, and processability.
Established relationships within the global transmission-belt industry are highly desirable.
Proven ability to manage technically complex sales cycles involving testing, qualification, supply approval, and multi-site customer coordination.
Experience negotiating pricing, supply agreements, development agreements, technical specifications, and long-term customer programs.
Strong commercial acumen, including margin management, value-based selling, forecasting, market analysis, and strategic account planning.
Professional fluency in English; additional languages are an advantage.
Willingness and ability to travel internationally.

Preferred Technical Background
The ideal candidate will have direct familiarity with one or more of the following:

Aramid, polyester, glass, carbon, hybrid, or other high-performance reinforcement materials.
Cord construction, twisting, cabling, dipping, coating, or adhesion-promotion systems.
Rubber-to-cord and polymer-to-cord adhesion technologies.
Belt fatigue testing, tensile testing, dynamic testing, flex testing, endurance testing, and field-performance validation.
Belt-manufacturing processes, including calendering, building, molding, curing, grinding, machining, and quality-control systems.
Customer qualification practices and industrial quality-assurance processes.

Personal Attributes

Credible technical expert who can communicate effectively with both R&D engineers and senior commercial leaders.
Entrepreneurial, proactive, and comfortable building business in technically demanding markets.
Structured and disciplined in account management, forecasting, and opportunity prioritization.
Skilled listener who can uncover the underlying technical and commercial drivers behind customer needs.
Collaborative leader who works effectively across sales, operations, R&D, quality, and supply chain.
Resilient and patient in managing long qualification cycles while maintaining urgency and commercial focus.
High integrity, sound judgment, and a strong commitment to confidentiality and ethical business conduct.

Benefits
This role offers the opportunity to shape the commercial direction of a high-value reinforcement business serving a critical industrial market. You will have the autonomy to influence strategy, engage directly with leading belt manufacturers, and help develop materials that enable more efficient, durable, lightweight, and sustainable power-transmission systems.

description_clean:

The Ads Team is a small but highly efficient team that combines technology and marketing to win customers over in the long term. Acquisition of new customers, advice, support and guide media agencies, trading desks and direct clients through our programmatic possibilities in a way they can understand.
Drawing up and negotiating bespoke programme packages, private deals or preferred deals.

4+ years of experience in Programmatic Advertising, SSP Management, or Programmatic Account Management (strong experience in CTV/Video)
A proven track record in the sales of digital advertising products
Deep understanding of Google Ad Manager, DSP/SSP workflows, OpenRTB specs, and deal types (Preferred Deals, PMP, PG)
Experience or strong technical familiarity with Header Bidding frameworks (e.g., Prebid) and SSP integrations
Strong network or understanding of the DACH Agency Trading Desk landscape
Fluent in German and English
Independent, strong communicator, able to work under pressure, with strong negotiation skills
Teamplayer and creative thinker with a questioning mindset.

At Zattoo, you’re always on firm ground with real freedom to explore. You’ll have the support and opportunity you need to go far, while you’re helping us create a sustainable and entertainment-filled future for all.

title: Senior Events & Brand Manager (f/m/x)
description_clean:
Your Mission
This is a company built for growth.
When you join exmox, you're stepping onto a global, highly competitive playing field, solving real problems in environments that push you beyond your comfort zone. We move fast, cut the noise, and focus on what actually matters, because in our industry, speed wins.
With 50M+ platform downloads, we’re rapidly scaling one of the most exciting innovations in mobile gaming: a rewarded user engagement and acquisition platform that helps players discover, and engage with games they enjoy - creating lasting value for both players and gaming studios.
As Senior Events & Brand Manager (f/m/x), you won't just be booking booths and ordering giveaways. You'll shape how exmox shows up at the industry's most important conferences, in the press and for our own team, deciding where we go, what we do there and how we make it count, turning events into moments that partners, talent and the industry remember. And 2027 starts big: the move of our Hamburg HQ to Mönckebergstraße and the opening of our Berlin office are yours to make unforgettable. 
At exmox, we're also embracing AI as part of how we work, not just what we build. We use AI tools to work smarter, cut down on repetitive tasks and spend our time where it actually moves the needle. If that mindset speaks to you, you'll fit right in.
If you bring taste, pace and a real feel for the mobile and tech scene, let's talk.
In this role you will:

Industry Events & Conferences: Plan and deliver exmox's presence at the conferences that matter in mobile gaming and adtech, from booths and speaking slots to side events and partner dinners, and help decide where we show up and where we skip.
Own Formats: Create events that are distinctly exmox, the kind partners make time for, and grow them into formats that come back year after year.
Office Openings: Lead the opening of our new Hamburg HQ and our Berlin office as brand moments, inside and outside the company.
PR: Steer our PR partners day to day, set priorities and turn our events and milestones into stories worth covering.
Internal Events & Merch: Shape the concept and experience of our internal events, with our Office Management team running the operations, and decide what merch and swag we produce, why and when, together with our Brand team.
Budget & Commercial Impact: Manage event budgets and suppliers, work with Sales and Account Management to turn every event into partner meetings and opportunities, and measure what each event and campaign delivers, so every euro is spent on impact rather than attendance.

What You Bring

Relevant Experience: You have 5 - 7 years of experience in event management, brand experience or experiential marketing, ideally in mobile gaming, adtech or another tech environment.
Proven Delivery: You've planned and delivered conference presences, side events and corporate events end to end, including budgets, vendors and on-site execution. Experience working with PR agencies or media is a plus.
Taste & Ideas: You know the difference between an event people attend and one they talk about, and you have the ideas to create the second kind.
Hands-On & Organized: You move easily between the big picture and the details, and you stay calm when things change at the last minute.
Communication Skills: Full professional fluency in English and German, and willingness to travel internationally.

How We Win

Speed is the feature. Speed beats rocket science. We move fast, test fast, and multiply our pace with AI, because action creates information and small wins compound. A fast failure is a lesson we learn from, a slow one is a problem we can't afford.
Focus on the essential. Done is better than perfect. We stay focused on what actually moves us forward and protect people's time from anything that doesn't. We're direct in how we communicate too, no rambling, no unnecessary detail.
See it. Own it. Solve it. The first to see it is best placed to fix it. We're not a place for comfort, we're a place for doers. "Not my job" isn't in our vocabulary, if you spot something, you help make sure it gets solved.
Respect others. Trust multiplies. Respect is non-negotiable. We disagree with ideas, never with people. Trust here is built the same way it is anywhere, through consistency, a thank you, a moment of listening, and owning your mistakes.
Perks that help you focus on what matters. Transport subsidy, learning budget, wellness and gym, workation, bi-weekly team lunches, and more. The perks are great, but the real reason people join and stay is the challenge, the ownership, and the drive to win together.

Mit validierten Methoden, die auf neusten Erkenntnissen der Psychologie und aktuellen Wissenschaft basieren, lernen Trauernde in unserer App und Web-Lösung gesunde Strategien zum Umgang mit ihrer Trauer. Wir wollen das sich niemand mehr in der Trauer alleine fühlt!grievy steht für die Enttabuisierung von Trauer in unserer Gesellschaft und die Unterstützung in den schwersten Zeiten des Lebens. Viele tausende Trauernde konnten wir bereits begleiten - doch wir wollen noch mehr!AufgabenAufgrund unseres starken Wachstums suchen wir ab sofort eine/n engagierte/n Werksstudent/in oder Teilzeitstelle (m/w/d) zur Unterstützung unseres Marketingteams. Deine Aufgaben umfassen:Du bist mit verantwortlich für die Content-Creation unserer Social Media Kanäle (Instagram, TikTok, Facebook und YouTube).Du drehst und schneidest Videos für unsere Kanäle und erstellst einfühlsame und ansprechende Postings.Du schreibst liebevolle, high-performing Captions und Content-Formate.Du unterstützt unsere CEO in Personal Brand Aktivitäten über grievy auf LinkedIn und Instagram.Du pflegst die Beziehungen zu unserer Community und begleitest sie einfühlsam in Kommentaren, WhatsApp, Mails und DMs.Du überwachst und analysierst Marketingaktivitäten und leitest Optimierungsmöglichkeiten ab.Du pflegst Beziehungen zu Journalisten, Redakteuren und anderen Medienvertretern und identifizierst PR-Chancen in relevanten Medienkanälen.QualifikationDu hast bereits Erfahrungen im digitalen Marketing, Content-Erstellung und Umsetzung von Marketingstrategien.Du bist nicht kamerascheu und hast ein Auge für Ästhetik.Du liebst Instagram, TikTok und Co. und spürst gerne neue Trends auf.Du bist bereit vom ersten Tag an ein hohes Maß an Eigenverantwortung zu übernehmen, arbeitest überdurchschnittlich gewissenhaft und hast sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse (Rechtschreibung und Grammatik).Im besten Fall hast du selbst erlebt, was ein Verlust im Leben verändert. Diese Perspektive ist für uns unglaublich wertvoll, denn sie hilft dir, die Fragen und Sorgen von Trauernden wirklich zu verstehen.Tod und Trauer gehören bei uns zum Arbeitsalltag. Du gehst offen und unverkrampft damit um und bringst die innere Stabilität mit, dich jeden Tag damit auseinanderzusetzen.Bei einer Tätigkeit als WerkstudentIn: Du absolvierst aktuell ein Studium oder eine Ausbildung im Bereich Design, Kommunikationswissenschaften, Geisteswissenschaften, Wirtschaftswissenschaften, Medien und Kommunikation, Psychologie, o.Ä.Du hast Erfahrung im Umgang mit Designtools (Canva, Instagram Edits) und kannst dich schnell in neue Software einarbeiten.BenefitsDu übernimmst vom ersten Tag an ein hohes Maß an Eigenverantwortung und bist Teil eines jungen, ambitionierten und dynamischen Teams, mit dem du unsere Erfolgsgeschichte aktiv mitgestaltest.Darüber hinaus erwartet dich:Steile Lernkurve durch eine intensive Einarbeitung und regelmäßige Feedbackgespräche für deine persönliche WeiterentwicklungFlexible Arbeitszeitmodelle mit Homeoffice-MöglichkeitenModernes Büro zum Wohlfühlen im lebendigen Kölner Stadtteil SülzGemeinsame Team Events (z. B. title: Content & Community Manager (m/w/d)
description_clean: Deine RolleWir sind HeyHoney, ein wachsendes Unternehmen mit einer treuen Community und einem klaren Produkt. Diese Community ist eines unserer wertvollsten Assets – und genau hier kommst du ins Spiel.Bei uns erwarten dich Verantwortung, Geschwindigkeit, Flexibilität und viel kreativer Gestaltungsraum – verbunden mit der Möglichkeit und Erwartung, diesen aktiv zu nutzen.Während unser Head of Performance & Growth die Skalierung verantwortet, machst du unsere Marke jeden Tag erlebbar: Du entwickelst unsere organischen Kanäle, unseren Content und unsere Community-Formate weiter – vom ersten Konzept bis zum fertigen Reel, vom Community-Kommentar bis zum Event.Dabei arbeitest du eng mit Creator, UGC-Creator und Freelancer zusammen und berichtest direkt an unsere Head of Performance & Growth.Dein VerantwortungsbereichContent & Social Media: Du betreust und entwickelst unsere organischen Kanäle – insbesondere Instagram, TikTok und Pinterest – und hast Trends, Plattform-Logiken und neue Formate immer im Blick.Content-Produktion: Du entwickelst Content-Ideen und setzt sie hands-on um – insbesondere Short-Form-Video. Dabei kannst du sowohl neuen Content produzieren als auch vorhandenes Material kreativ weiterdenken und daraus neue, plattformgerechte Inhalte entwickeln. Für Produktionen arbeitest du bei Bedarf mit UGC-Creator und Freelancer zusammen und steuerst diese eigenständig.Creator & UGC: Du identifizierst relevante Creator, baust Beziehungen auf und entwickelst ein nachhaltiges Netzwerk aus UGC-Creator, Freelancer und Partner, das unsere Marke langfristig voranbringt.Community Management: Du bist eine der Stimmen von HeyHoney. Du interagierst regelmäßig mit unserer Community, aktivierst sie und entwickelst Ideen, mit denen aus Kund echte Fans werden. Dabei entwickelst du Community-Formate, die Bindung und Retention stärken.Community Events: Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit dem Team Ideen für Community Events und begleitest deren Umsetzung – von Planung und Partner-/Location-Auswahl bis zur Durchführung und Nachbereitung.Launch-Support: Für unsere Kollektions-Launches entwickelst du organische Content- und Community-Ideen und verzahnst sie eng mit unseren Paid-Aktivitäten.Analytics & Reporting: Du behältst relevante KPIs wie Reichweite, Engagement und Community-Wachstum im Blick, erkennst, welche Inhalte funktionieren, und leitest daraus konkrete Learnings und neue Content-Ideen ab.Was du mitbringstDu fühlst dich auf Social Media zu Hause und verstehst, warum Content funktioniert – oder eben nicht. Dabei ist uns dein Gespür für Content, Community und relevante KPIs wichtiger als eine bestimmte Anzahl an Berufsjahren.Idealerweise bringst du mindestens ein Jahr praktische Erfahrung im Bereich Social Media, Content oder Community mit – zum Beispiel aus einer Festanstellung, Werkstudentätigkeit, einem Praktikum, Freelance-Projekten oder eigenen Social-Media-Projekten.Du bist hands-on: Du kannst Content von der Idee bis zur Umsetzung begleiten und hast ein gutes Auge für Ästhetik, Trends und die unterschiedlichen Logiken von Instagram, TikTok & Co.Du verstehst Content Creation: Du kannst selbst drehen und schneiden und weißt gleichzeitig, wann Creator, UGC oder Freelancer die bessere Lösung sind. Du musst dabei nicht zwingend selbst vor der Kamera stehen – wichtiger ist, dass du gute Inhalte erkennst, entwickeln und umsetzen kannst.Du kannst Community: Du verstehst, wie aus Reichweite Interaktion und aus Interaktion echte Bindung entsteht. Wenn du bereits eine Community oder eigene Social-Media-Kanäle aufgebaut hast, umso besser.Du schreibst markensicher: Du hast ein gutes Sprachgefühl und triffst den Ton einer modernen Lifestyle-Brand.Du denkst in Zahlen: Reichweite, Engagement Rate, Watch Time oder Community-Wachstum sind für dich nicht nur Reporting-Zahlen. Du nutzt sie, um zu verstehen, was funktioniert und was wir beim nächsten Mal besser machen können.Du setzt um: Du wartest nicht darauf, dass dir jeder einzelne Schritt vorgegeben wird. Du bringst Ideen ein, probierst Dinge aus, lernst daraus und treibst deine Themen eigenständig voran.Uns ist dabei nicht wichtig, dass du schon jede dieser Aufgaben perfekt beherrschst. Wenn du Social Media verstehst, Lust hast, Verantwortung zu übernehmen, schnell lernst und HeyHoney gemeinsam mit uns weiterentwickeln möchtest, wollen wir dich kennenlernen.Was wir dir bietenContent, Community und Events sind bei uns bewusst noch nicht auserzählt. Das bedeutet: Du kommst nicht in ein fertiges System, sondern kannst aktiv mitgestalten.Echter Gestaltungsspielraum: Ein kleines, schnelles Team, kurze Wege und die Freiheit, Strukturen, Formate und Ideen selbst mit aufzubauen – im direkten Sparring mit unserer Head of Performance & Growth.Flexibles Arbeitsmodell: Wir sind Remote-First und offen für unterschiedliche Modelle – Vollzeit, Teilzeit oder Werkstudent. Entscheidend sind für uns dein Beitrag, deine Fähigkeiten und der messbare Output, nicht deine Anwesenheit im Büro.Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten: Die Rolle kann mit dir wachsen. Wenn du Verantwortung übernehmen möchtest und zeigst, dass deine Ideen funktionieren, bekommst du bei uns den Raum dafür.Miteinander, das zur Marke passt: Wir sind ein herzliches, offenes Team und leben den HeyHoney-Spirit auch intern – mit Augenhöhe, Vertrauen und einem wertschätzenden Miteinander, das auch über die Distanz trägt.Lust, HeyHoney mit aufzubauen?Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung.Zeig uns dabei gerne mehr als deinen Lebenslauf: Welche Accounts, Reels, TikToks oder Formate findest du richtig gut? Was hast du selbst schon umgesetzt? Welche Community oder welchen Kanal hast du mitentwickelt?Links zu eigenen Accounts, Content-Beispielen, UGC-Projekten oder Events sind sehr willkommen. Auch eigene Projekte zählen für uns – es muss nicht alles aus einer klassischen Festanstellung stammen.Bei HeyHoney zählt, was du kannst und einbringst – unabhängig von Alter, Geschlecht und geschlechtlicher Identität, Nationalität und Herkunft, Religion und Weltanschauung, sexueller Orientierung, einer Behinderung oder deiner sozialen Herkunft. Wir bewerten Bewerbungen ausschließlich nach fachlicher Eignung und freuen uns über jede Perspektive, die unser Team vielfältiger macht.Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung!Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Expansion Customer Success Manager (m/w/d)
description_clean:
Pflegia ist eine digitale Plattform zur Vermittlung von Pflegekräften.
Unsere Mission: Pflegeeinrichtungen und qualifizierte Fachkräfte schnell, fair und passgenau zusammenzubringen – mit digitalen Lösungen, die wirklich funktionieren. 
Wir sind ein wachsendes Unternehmen mit Hauptsitz in Berlin, das auf Eigenverantwortung, transparente Kommunikation und partnerschaftliches Arbeiten setzt. Für das nächste Kapitel unserer Erfolgsgeschichte schlagen wir eine Brücke nach Westeuropa: Von unserem Headquarter in Berlin aus starten wir die Expansion in den französischen Markt. Dafür suchen wir empathische und umsetzungsstarke Talente im Customer Success, die den Beziehungsaufbau zu französischen Pflegekräften von Tag 1 an mitgestalten.

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer
description_clean:
Quarzo Life construit une nouvelle génération de plateforme d’assurance vie combinant excellence opérationnelle, expérience utilisateur moderne et forte ambition technologique.
Après avoir construit notre MVP et posé les premiers standards engineering, nous renforçons aujourd’hui notre équipe technique interne autour de notre Founding Engineer / Lead Developer.
Nous recherchons un Senior Full Stack Engineer capable de prendre rapidement l’ownership de domaines fonctionnels importants de notre plateforme, d’accélérer le delivery produit et de contribuer directement à sa fiabilité en production.
Vous rejoindrez l’aventure à un moment clé : la base technique est déjà posée, le MVP est proche de sa mise en production et l’enjeu est désormais de faire évoluer rapidement la plateforme tout en renforçant sa robustesse, son observabilité, sa sécurité et sa maintenabilité.
Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec notre Founding Engineer / Lead Developer, qui porte la cohérence technique globale, l’architecture et la structuration progressive de l’équipe engineering, ainsi qu’avec Ferréol Robert, fondateur CPTO.
Votre rôle sera avant tout celui d’un builder avec un ownership de production : comprendre des problématiques métier complexes, concevoir des solutions simples et robustes, les développer de bout en bout, les mettre en production, puis vous assurer qu’elles fonctionnent correctement dans la durée.
Chez Quarzo Life, le travail d’un ingénieur ne s’arrête pas au merge d’une pull request : you build it, you run it.
Les compétences clés attendues incluent une solide culture technique full-stack, avec une capacité à intervenir efficacement sur plusieurs dimensions du produit (front, back, données, infrastructure et production) sans nécessairement être expert sur chacune.
Nous recherchons surtout un profil capable de prendre l’ownership d’un problème plutôt que d’exécuter une liste de tickets : comprendre le besoin, challenger la solution, construire, livrer, observer et améliorer.
Le rôle pourra évoluer avec la croissance de Quarzo Life vers davantage de responsabilités techniques selon les compétences et aspirations du candidat.
Vos missions
Product engineering & delivery

Concevoir et développer des fonctionnalités produit de bout en bout sur notre stack TypeScript et React.
Prendre progressivement l’ownership technique de plusieurs domaines fonctionnels de la plateforme.
Participer activement à la discovery produit et à la conception fonctionnelle.
Challenger les spécifications lorsque cela permet d’améliorer le produit, de réduire la complexité ou d’accélérer le delivery.
Livrer régulièrement des fonctionnalités utilisables en production avec un haut niveau d’autonomie.

Production, run & observabilité
La plateforme Quarzo Life porte des opérations financières et assurantielles critiques. Son exploitation quotidienne fait donc pleinement partie du rôle de l’équipe engineering. Vous participerez directement au run de la production et serez progressivement autonome sur l’exploitation des services dont vous avez la responsabilité.
Vous serez notamment amené à :

surveiller quotidiennement la santé des applications et services en production ;
analyser les logs, métriques, traces et alertes afin d’identifier rapidement les anomalies ;
construire et améliorer les dashboards permettant de suivre les principaux composants et flux de la plateforme ;
investiguer les incidents de production jusqu’à identification de leur cause racine ;
suivre le bon fonctionnement des principaux flux métier et techniques ;
participer aux déploiements et vérifier leur bon déroulement en production ;
contribuer aux procédures de rollback, reprise, sauvegarde et restauration ;
réaliser des root cause analyses et post-mortems lorsqu’un incident significatif survient ;
mettre en œuvre les actions correctrices permettant d’éviter la répétition des incidents ;
identifier les opérations manuelles fragiles ou répétitives et les automatiser ;
participer, à mesure que l’équipe grandit, à une organisation d’astreinte adaptée à la criticité du service.

L’objectif est que chaque Senior Engineer puisse progressivement opérer de manière autonome les services qu’il développe, sans faire du Lead Developer le point de passage systématique pour chaque incident.
Infrastructure, DevOps & reliability
Sans nécessairement être un spécialiste DevOps ou SRE, vous devez être à l’aise avec l’environnement dans lequel votre code fonctionne.
Vous contribuerez notamment à :

intervenir sur les pipelines CI/CD ;
contribuer aux pratiques Infrastructure as Code ;
comprendre les problématiques de networking applicatif, configuration, secrets et dépendances externes ;
suivre les bases de données ;
améliorer les procédures de déploiement et de recovery ;
contribuer aux sujets de continuité et reprise d’activité.

Le Founding Engineer / Lead Developer conserve la responsabilité de la cohérence globale de l’architecture et des standards de plateforme, mais chaque Senior Engineer porte la fiabilité opérationnelle de son périmètre.
Software craftsmanship & qualité

Adhérer et faire vivre aux valeurs de l'artisanat logiciel.
Produire un code lisible, testé, documenté et maintenable.
Contribuer à faire progresser collectivement la qualité du codebase.
Appliquer et enrichir les standards engineering : tests automatisés, CI/CD, documentation, observabilité et sécurité.
Identifier spontanément les zones de dette technique et proposer des améliorations proportionnées aux enjeux.
Utiliser les pratiques DDD, TDD et les principes de clean architecture, sans dogmatisme.
Concevoir les fonctionnalités en anticipant leur exploitation et leur diagnostic en production.
Considérer logs, métriques, alertes et gestion des erreurs comme faisant partie intégrante d’une fonctionnalité terminée.

Sécurité & conformité
En tant qu’assureur, Quarzo Life évolue dans un environnement particulièrement exigeant en matière de fiabilité, de sécurité et de traçabilité.
Vous contribuerez notamment à :

intégrer les principes de security et privacy by design dans les développements ;
renforcer la sécurité applicative et infrastructure ;
assurer la traçabilité des traitements et événements importants ;
participer aux chantiers techniques liés à notre trajectoire ISO 27001 ;
contribuer à la gestion des vulnérabilités et à la sécurisation des dépendances ;
prendre en compte les exigences de résilience et de continuité propres à une plateforme financière régulée.

AI-native engineering
Nous considérons les outils IA comme une nouvelle composante du métier de software engineer.
Nous attendons de nos développeurs qu’ils sachent utiliser intelligemment les assistants de développement et LLM pour accélérer leur travail tout en conservant une forte capacité de jugement sur l’architecture, le code produit et la sécurité.
Vous serez notamment amené à :

utiliser les outils d’AI-assisted development pour accélérer exploration, développement, tests, debugging et documentation ;
comprendre et challenger le code généré plutôt que de simplement l’accepter ;
identifier des usages IA pertinents dans notre produit et nos outils internes ;
contribuer à définir les bonnes pratiques de l’équipe autour de ces nouveaux outils.

Excellente maîtrise de TypeScript et expérience backend type NodeJS.
Bonne expérience React et développement frontend moderne.
Très bonne maîtrise des principes de conception logicielle et des APIs.

Capacité à diagnostiquer un système distribué à partir de logs, métriques et traces.
Bonne compréhension des environnements cloud et de l’infrastructure applicative.
Bonne compréhension des enjeux de performance, disponibilité, sauvegarde et reprise.
Sensibilité forte aux enjeux de sécurité applicative.
Bonne compréhension des usages IA / LLM appliqués au développement logiciel.

Nous recherchons un profil full-stack au sens produit et production : il n’est pas nécessaire d’être expert de chaque couche, mais vous devez être capable de comprendre une fonctionnalité depuis son interface utilisateur jusqu’à son fonctionnement en production et d’intervenir là où cela crée le plus de valeur.

mettre une fonctionnalité en production ne constitue pas la fin du travail ;

title: Infrastructure & Operations Engineer (m/w/d)
description_clean:
Wir sind Oxoia und skalieren Nachhaltigkeit — durch Infrastruktur, auf die sich Gebäude in der ganzen Schweiz verlassen
Gebäude verursachen bis zu 40 % der weltweiten CO2-Emissionen, meist durch ineffizienten Betrieb. Unsere Antwort? Eine KI-gestützte Plug-and-Play-Optimierungslösung, die den Energieverbrauch massiv senkt, Betriebskosten um bis zu 35 % reduziert und sich oft in weniger als einem Jahr amortisiert. Namen wie die SBB, der Flughafen Zürich oder Mobimo vertrauen bereits auf uns.
Unsere Software wertet Gebäude aus und steuert sie auch direkt vor Ort. Wir wachsen schnell, und der Betrieb muss mitwachsen. Genau hier kommst du ins Spiel: Wir suchen dich als Infrastructure & Operations Engineer, um aus bestehenden Grundlagen einen Betrieb zu machen, der auch bei einem Vielfachen der heutigen Grösse trägt — und um ihn danach zu verantworten!
Aufgaben
Deine Aufgaben als Infrastructure & Operations Engineer

Betrieb und Automatisierung: Du führst unsere bestehenden Werkzeuge zu einem durchgängigen System zusammen und entwickelst es weiter.
Flottenbetrieb skalieren: Du machst den Betrieb bereit für eine stark wachsende Geräteflotte in Kundengebäuden — mit verlässlichen, automatisierten Rollouts.
Gebäudeanlagen absichern: Du verantwortest Netzwerksegmentierung, Zugriffskontrolle und sichere Fernzugänge zu unseren Geräten und den Anlagen dahinter.
Plattform betreiben und härten: Du betreibst unsere eigene Infrastruktur und machst sie fit für die nächsten Jahre — von Storage über Kapazitätsplanung bis zu Runbooks.
Zugänge und Nachweise: Du gestaltest den Lebenszyklus von Zertifikaten, Dienstkonten und Zugriffsrechten und sorgst dafür, dass Audit-Nachweise im Alltag automatisch entstehen.
Präsenz: Du bist dort, wo die Anlagen stehen — bei Kundenstandorten, im Rechenzentrum, im Office in Baden oder flexibel aus dem Homeoffice.

Qualifikation
Das bringst du mit

Betriebs-DNA: Du bringst Systeme zum Laufen und hältst sie am Laufen. Du bringst zu Ende, was du anfängst, und übernimmst Verantwortung für das, was danach im Betrieb ist.
Technisches Fundament: Linux im Betrieb, nicht nur in der Anwendung — Systemd, Netzwerkstack, Fehlersuche an laufenden Systemen. Dazu Netzwerk mit Substanz: Routing, NAT, Firewalling, VPN, Segmentierung.
Automatisierung: Infrastruktur als Code ist für dich Alltag. Git ist deine Arbeitsweise, nicht dein Ablageort.
Skripting: Python und Bash, um Werkzeuge zu bauen und Daten auszuwerten. Dazu SQL, um Betriebsdaten selbst abzufragen, statt auf ein Dashboard zu warten.
Agentic Coding: Du arbeitest selbstverständlich mit KI-Agenten wie Claude Code, Codex oder Cursor. Du weisst, wie man eine Aufgabe so zuschneidet, dass ein Agent sie zuverlässig löst, und erkennst, wann du besser nicht delegierst.
Urteilsvermögen: Du kannst Code lesen und beurteilen, auch in Sprachen, in denen du nicht selbst entwickelst. Bei uns entsteht viel mit Agenten — das Prüfen und Entscheiden ist die eigentliche Arbeit, besonders wenn eine Änderung die ganze Flotte erreicht.
Feld- oder Flottenerfahrung: Du hast mit verteilten Geräteflotten gearbeitet oder kommst aus der Anlagentechnik und weisst, was es bedeutet, wenn ein Update ein Gebäude erwischt.
Sprachen: Deutsch und Englisch.

Wertvoll, aber keine Voraussetzung: Erfahrung mit Virtualisierung und verteiltem Storage, Datenbanken, Gebäudeautomations-Protokollen, Kubernetes sowie IEC 62443 oder ISO 27001 aus der Praxis. Zertifikate ohne Praxis brauchen wir nicht.
Benefits
Das bieten wir dir

Entscheidungsspielraum statt Zuarbeit: Du baust die Infrastruktur, die du danach betreibst. Architektur und Betriebsmodell liegen bei dir, nicht bei einem Gremium.
Eine Strategie statt eines Blankoblatts: Die Grundlagen sind erarbeitet. Du fängst nicht bei null an — und auch nicht in einem fertigen System, in dem nichts mehr zu entscheiden ist.
Ein Problem, das es so selten gibt: Eine Geräteflotte, die stark wächst, und Infrastruktur, deren Fehler nicht in einem Ticket enden, sondern in einem Gebäude. Wer Gebäudetechnik und IT-Betrieb verbinden will, findet das nicht an vielen Orten.
Kurze Wege: Ein kleines Team, keine Zwischenebenen, kein Konzernprozess. Was am Montag entschieden wird, läuft am Mittwoch.
Agentic Coding als Standard: Wir arbeiten konsequent mit KI-Agenten, finanzieren die Werkzeuge dafür und entwickeln die Arbeitsweise gemeinsam weiter. Wer das schon kann, wird hier nicht ausgebremst.

Ehrlich vorab: Wir sind ein kleines Team, und diese Rolle ist neu. Vieles wirst du selbst gestalten, statt es vorzufinden — von Runbooks bis zu Bereitschaftsregeln. Wenn dich genau das reizt, passt es gut. Wer eine eingespielte Betriebsorganisation sucht, wird bei uns nicht glücklich.
Dafür arbeitest du an etwas, das messbar wirkt: Jedes Gebäude, das effizienter läuft, zählt doppelt — für unsere Kunden und für die CO2-Bilanz.
Kein klassisches Motivationsschreiben nötig. Beschreib uns im Anschreiben stattdessen in ein paar Sätzen, woran du zuletzt gearbeitet hast und was dabei schiefgegangen ist — das sagt uns mehr als jede Floskel.

title: Consultant Revenue Management H/F
description_clean:
Spécialiste du revenue management externalisé depuis 18 ans, Xperteo accompagne des groupes hôteliers et établissements indépendants dans l’optimisation de leur performance.
Dans le cadre de notre développement, nous recherchons un(e) Consultant(e) Revenue Management & Distribution expérimenté(e).
Vos missions
Rattaché(e) à votre Team Leader, vous êtes responsable de la performance revenue et distribution d’un portefeuille d’hôtels.
Véritable partenaire stratégique des établissements, vous intervenez à la fois sur le pilotage opérationnel et le conseil.  
Pilotage d’un portefeuille hôtels :

Définir et piloter la stratégie tarifaire et de distribution
Analyser la performance : occupation, ADR, RevPAR, pick-up, paceSuivre et optimiser les résultats au quotidien
Fixer les objectifs mensuels et annuels avec les clients
Identifier les leviers de croissance et recommander des actions concrètes

Relation client & conseil

Être l’interlocuteur(trice) privilégié(e) des hôtels
Animer des points réguliers avec les directeurs et exploitants
Construire une relation de confiance dans une logique de partenariat long terme
Garantir la satisfaction client et la reconduction des contrats

Distribution & outils

Piloter le channel management et la visibilité en ligne
Gérer et contrôler les mises à jour sur PMS, RMS, Channel Manager, OTA
Assurer une utilisation optimale des outils métiers

Reporting & recommandations

Produire des analyses régulières et des reportings stratégiques
Formuler des recommandations argumentées et actionnables

Contribution interne

Participer à l’amélioration continue des process
Être force de proposition sur les sujets opérationnels et organisationnels
Accompagner ponctuellement les profils plus juniors

Vos compétences
Expérience requise

Minimum 2 à 5 ans d’expérience en revenue management hôtelier
Expérience en gestion de portefeuille multi-hôtels appréciée
Solide compréhension des enjeux de distribution et de pricing

Compétences techniques

Maîtrise avancée d’Excel
Bonne connaissance des outils : RMS, PMS, CRS, Channel Manager, Rate Shopper
Aisance avec les environnements data et les outils digitaux
Connaissance des marques & chaînes est un plus

Soft skills

Esprit analytique et orientation résultats
Excellentes capacités relationnelles et de communication
Sens du service client et posture de conseil
Autonomie, rigueur et organisation
Capacité à convaincre et à argumenter
